name: app.mathapex/worksheets
title: MathApex Worksheets
description: Printable math worksheets for grades 1–4 with answer keys, in German, English, French and Spanish.

tools.name: list_worksheet_topics
tools.description: Lists the worksheet topics and their choices (number range, times table or focus), optionally only those offered for one school grade (1–4). Labels come in the requested language.

language.description: Language of the sheet: de (German school notation), en (US school notation), fr or es.

grade.description: School grade 1–4; only the topics and choices offered for this grade are listed.

tools.name: create_worksheet
tools.description: Creates one printable math worksheet: five tasks, a brain teaser and a wide task, with the full answer key and a link that opens the same sheet as two A4 pages for printing. addition, subtraction and plus-minus take range 20, 100 or 1000; place-value takes range 100, 1000 or 1000000; times and division take table 2–10 or 'mixed'; written, quantities, word-problems and geometry take one of the foci listed in the focus parameter. With a grade and no range, table or focus, the sheet of that grade is chosen; a note in the result says when a sheet is printed for another grade. The same seed always gives the same sheet; without a seed the numbers are new.

language.description: Language of the sheet: de (German school notation), en (US school notation), fr or es.

grade.description: School grade 1–4 the user asked for. Chooses the matching range when none is given; the printed grade still follows the content.

range.description: Number range for addition, subtraction, plus-minus (20, 100, 1000) and place-value (100, 1000, 1000000).

table.description: Times table 2–10 or 'mixed', for times and division.

focus.description: Focus for written, quantities, word-problems and geometry.

seed.description: Optional number 1–999999 that reproduces a sheet; without it the sheet gets new numbers.
